_source: Static UI keys for the mobile PR approve action sheet (route approve, pototype/mobile.jsx MobileApproveSheet L393-458). KEYS ONLY — every value is the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key (read with tp). All NEW keys are collected in agents/orch-b-recon/mobile-approve-reject-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (B-255); they already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. `confirmBody` carries {no}/{amount} placeholder slots — the screen substitutes the REAL wire values (PR no + server amount, authority=SERVER) via a split-on-token Text.rich; Wei's en/zh/ar MUST keep both tokens. The ฿ is dict subcon.unitBaht (not a phrase key). The prototype next-approver card + optional note are OMITTED (approval-chain=B-252 wire gap; approve endpoint is path-id only, no note wire) — not represented here.
_layers: all tp() = phrases (the Thai phrase is the key); ฿ via dict subcon.unitBaht
